Independent primary-source intake for the next discriminating experiment, with no campaign/candidate changes:

[NASA's public additive-manufacturing disk dataset](https://ntrs.nasa.gov/citations/20240002767) provides XCT plus a separate optical-profilometry modality for surface-breaking pores. The 21,336,333-byte profilometry ZIP was acquired and hash-checked (SHA256 `f64d9139042ba7adc0a7d6a4174a52c9745a7264d0dc1ddb6866d2f1d19913b0`). An owned bounded binary-header check found a real ingestion constraint: the height TIFF is 3259×3195 with BitsPerSample64 / SampleFormat3, despite the description calling it single precision. Its strip size83,300,040 matches8×3259×3195. A float32 assumption from prose would be wrong; ordinary TIFF readers should use the actual header. This is an intake repair requirement, not an enabling/business result.

The independently measured modality is a better candidate reference than treating a reconstructed full-view image as physical truth. However, the catalogue supplies reconstructed XCT volumes rather than calibrated raw rays; complete repeatability/registration/error bounds remain missing. Resolution figures are not deterministic feature-error guarantees. The [published2024 registration/segmentation route](https://ntrs.nasa.gov/api/citations/20240002879/downloads/spie_smart_structures_2024_final.pdf) and [2025 occlusion-aware extension](https://ntrs.nasa.gov/api/citations/20250002676/downloads/SPIE2025_Frankforter_XCT_Profilometry_Integration.pdf?attachment=true) must be competent conventional controls. This possibility is INVESTIGATED, not admitted.

The low-resolution XCT file is196,666,399bytes, exceeding this intake's128MiB ceiling; it was not downloaded. Total preserved intake/artifacts35,146,382bytes; no spending, account/access changes, untrusted-code execution or public-file edits. NIST alternatives also exposed why a0.5µm optical-resolution component cannot substitute for a total uncertainty budget or hard pixelwise bound.

Next owner action, only within a prospectively recorded allocation: freeze an actual surface-pore obligation and registration/error treatment, acquire the remaining lawful bytes if justified, run the published complete ordinary route first, and test a consequential retained improvement. If that route already satisfies the obligation economically, reject the gap. Do not recast the current source/header check as the flagship.

Intake manifest SHA256 `3dfe51a326066accdaff6cd411f565b71a92135cf7ab62fb375508e3c7c5c06c`; local review/source records are ready for the integration owner's publication. No protected confirmation or new claim-level error allocation was consumed.
